literal: On wuchen day Goryeo dispatched ten youths to come study the native language.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Goryeo sent ten youths to study the Khitan language.

literal: Twelfth month, on jimao day the Iron Li dispatched envoys to come with tribute of hawks and horses.
idiomatic: On jimao day in the twelfth month the Iron Li sent envoys with tribute of hawks and horses.

literal: On xinsi day Western Xia, because it had defeated Song troops, dispatched envoys to come report.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Western Xia sent envoys to report its victory over Song troops.

literal: That year jinshi Wang Yongji and one other were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Wang Yongji and one other passed the examinations.

literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on jiyou day fished on the Lu River.
idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on jiyou day in the first spring month, the court went fishing on the Lu River.

literal: On dingsi day remitted tax and levies of the three capitals and the various prefectures.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict remitted taxes and levies in the three capitals and the various prefectures.

literal: On bingyin day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengwu day household slave Yan Gui of Palace Attendant Amoli was made prefect of Feng Prefecture.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Yan Gui, a household slave of palace attendant Amoli, was appointed prefect of Feng Prefecture.

literal: Second month, on gengyin day the Uyghur dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengyin day in the second month the Uyghur sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, on renyin day Goryeo King Wang Zhi memorialized begging for marriage; it was granted that the daughter of Eastern Capital regent and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hengde be given in marriage to him.
idiomatic: On renyin day in the third month Goryeo King Wang Zhi asked to marry; the court agreed to give him the daughter of Eastern Capital regent and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hengde.

literal: On gengxu day Goryeo again dispatched ten youths to come study the native language.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Goryeo again sent ten youths to study the Khitan language.

literal: On jiayin day Han Dewei memorialized victory in campaigning against the Tangut.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Han Dewei reported victory over the Tangut.

literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered resettlement and pacification of displaced people of Shuo Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered resettlement and relief for displaced people in Shuo Prefecture.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiaxu day each of the eastern tribes was given its own overseer.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fourth summer month each eastern tribe was given its own overseer.

literal: On gengyin day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: On jihai day Mount Da'an was excavated and the money Liu Shouguang had hidden was taken.
idiomatic: On jihai day Mount Da'an was excavated and the treasure Liu Shouguang had hidden there was recovered.

literal: That month, Xi King Heshuonu, Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde, and three others, because they had failed to subdue the Wu'er, had their offices reduced.
idiomatic: That month Xi King Heshuonu, Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde, and three others were demoted for failing to subdue the Wu'er.

literal: The various tribes' lingwen were changed to military commissioners.
idiomatic: The various tribes' lingwen posts were converted to military commissioner posts.

literal: Fifth month, on guimao day an edict ordered associate state counselor Xing Baopu to decide Nanjing's backlog of cases.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the fifth month an edict ordered associate state counselor Xing Baopu to decide delayed cases at Nanjing.

literal: On gengxu day one hundred seven men of Shuo Prefecture's Weisheng Army rebelled and entered Song.
idiomatic: On gengxu day one hundred seven soldiers of Shuo Prefecture's Weisheng Army defected to Song.

literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: The Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: The Iron Li sent tribute.

literal: On yiyou day the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the Uyghur sent tribute.

literal: On jichou day Goryeo dispatched envoys to come inquire after the Emperor's health.
idiomatic: On jichou day Goryeo sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health.

literal: Later arrivals had no fixed time.
idiomatic: Later envoys arrived at irregular intervals.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day the Uyghur and others came with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuwu day in the seventh autumn month the Uyghur and others sent tribute.

literal: Intercalary month, on dingchou day the Five Courts Division presented gold and horses obtained from excavating a cave site.
idiomatic: On dingchou day in the intercalary month the Five Courts Division presented gold and horses found while excavating a cave.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingchen day Liu Sui was ordered to teach sword methods to the soldiers of Nanjing's Shenwu Army, and robes, belts, brocade, and coins were granted.
idiomatic: On bingchen day in the tenth winter month Liu Sui was ordered to teach sword fighting to Nanjing's Shenwu Army, and robes, belts, brocade, and coins were granted.

literal: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu begged to come submit internally.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu asked to submit and be incorporated.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day an edict ordered army officers not to hunt out of season and harm farming.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the eleventh month an edict forbade army officers from hunting out of season and harming the harvest.

literal: On yiyou day stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Qian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On yiyou day stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Qian Prefecture.

literal: That month, Arsalan Uyghur dispatched envoys to seek marriage for his son; it was not granted.
idiomatic: That month Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys asking to marry his son into the court; the request was refused.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiayin day because the newly fixed tax law of the Nanjing circuit was too heavy, it was reduced.
idiomatic: On jiayin day in the twelfth month the newly fixed tax law of the Nanjing circuit was reduced because it was too heavy.

literal: On jiazi day Talin lured rebel chieftains Arudun and sixty others and beheaded them; he was enfeoffed Duke of Lanling.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Talin lured rebel chieftains including Arudun, beheaded sixty of them, and was enfeoffed Duke of Lanling.

literal: Visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: The court visited Nanjing.

literal: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and two others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and two others passed the examinations.

literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, on gengwu day visited Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on gengwu day in the first spring month, the court visited Yanfang Marsh.

literal: On bingzi day because the Tangut west of the river had rebelled, an edict ordered Han Dewei to campaign against them.
idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict ordered Han Dewei to campaign against the Tangut west of the river who had rebelled.

literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage the people to plant trees.
idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage tree planting.

literal: On guimao day the Wu'er chief Wuzhou came to surrender.
idiomatic: On guimao day the Wu'er chief Wuzhou surrendered.

literal: On wuzi day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jichou day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide backlog prisoners.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered Nanjing to clear its backlog of prisoners.

literal: On yiwei day remitted taxes of displaced people.
idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict remitted taxes owed by displaced people.

literal: Second month, on bingshen new moon: visited Changchun Palace.
idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the second month the court visited Changchun Palace.

literal: On wuxu day the Pinbu division's wealthy households were urged to contribute money to support the poor.
idiomatic: On wuxu day wealthy households of the Pinbu division were urged to contribute money to support the poor.

literal: On gengzi day the people of Liangmen, Suicheng, Taizhou, and Beiping were moved to the interior.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the people of Liangmen, Suicheng, Taizhou, and Beiping were relocated inland.

literal: On bingwu day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: On bingchen day Han Dewei memorialized victory in breaking the Tangut.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Han Dewei reported victory over the Tangut.

literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered vacant land of the Pinbu division given to the people to farm.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered vacant Pinbu land opened to civilian cultivation.

literal: Third month, on yichou new moon: the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the third month the Tangut sent tribute.

literal: On wuchen day the people were recruited to farm wasteland in Luan Prefecture, remitting their tax and levies for ten years.
idiomatic: On wuchen day civilians were recruited to farm wasteland in Luan Prefecture with tax and corvée remitted for ten years.

literal: On jisi day Western Xia broke Song troops and dispatched envoys to come report.
idiomatic: On jisi day Western Xia defeated Song troops and sent envoys to report the victory.

literal: On jimao day Western Xia King Li Jiqian was enfeoffed King of Xiping.
idiomatic: On jimao day Western Xia King Li Jiqian was enfeoffed King of Xiping.

literal: On renwu day palace household registers were comprehensively checked; Nanjing's tax arrears and charity-granary grain were remitted.
idiomatic: On renwu day palace household registers were comprehensively checked and Nanjing's tax arrears and charity-granary grain were remitted.

literal: On jiashen day the Tangut west of the river begged to come submit internally.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the Tangut west of the river asked to submit and be incorporated.

literal: On gengyin day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, because his land was distant, begged to be exempted yearly from presenting hawks, horses, and sable pelts; an edict ordered tribute on the birthday and New Year's Day as before, the rest exempted.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, citing the distance of his territory, asked to be exempted from yearly tribute of hawks, horses, and sable pelts; an edict kept birthday and New Year's tribute as before and exempted the rest.

literal: On guisi day the Song ruler Jiong died; his son Heng succeeded to the throne.
idiomatic: On guisi day the Song emperor Zhao Jiong died and his son Zhao Heng succeeded to the throne.

literal: On jiawu day the Grand Imperial Consort presented western frontier victory.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Grand Imperial Consort reported victory on the western frontier.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiwei new moon: abolished the yearly tribute of zheng from the five Xi divisions.
idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the fourth summer month the yearly zheng tribute of the five Xi divisions was abolished.

literal: On wuxu day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: On renyin day charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Nanjing's various counties.
idiomatic: On renyin day charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Nanjing's counties.

literal: On bingwu day Guangde Army military commissioner Han Ningning had benevolent government; when his term ended the people asked that he remain; it was granted.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Guangde Army military commissioner Han Ningning, whose benevolent rule the people wished to retain at term's end, was allowed to stay.

literal: On jiyou day visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court visited Nanjing.

literal: On dingsi day offerings were made at Emperor Taizong's temple.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the court offered rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.

literal: On jiwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: Fifth month, on jiazi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On jisi day an edict ordered Ping Prefecture to decide backlog cases.
idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered Ping Prefecture to clear its backlog of cases.

literal: That month, the eight Jilie divisions killed their xiangwen and rebelled; Xiao Talin pursued and struck them, capturing half the tribes.
idiomatic: That month the eight Jilie divisions killed their xiangwen and rebelled; Xiao Talin pursued them and captured half the tribes.

literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingshen day in the sixth month the Iron Li sent tribute.

literal: On renzi day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come thank the enfeoffment and investiture.
idiomatic: On renzi day Western Xia sent envoys to thank the court for the enfeoffment.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh autumn month the Tangut sent tribute.

literal: On xinwei day the separate division of the Tuyuhun was forbidden to sell horses to Song.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the separate Tuyuhun division was forbidden to sell horses to Song.

literal: On bingzi day Goryeo dispatched Han Yanjing to present gifts and mourn the death of the Princess of Yue State.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Goryeo sent Han Yanjing with gifts to mourn the death of the Princess of Yue.

literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide prison cases swiftly.
idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide lawsuits quickly.

literal: Eighth month, on dingyou day hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest; the Empress Dowager admonished, saying: "The former sages had a saying: desire must not be indulged.
idiomatic: On dingyou day in the eighth month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest; the Empress Dowager admonished him, saying, "The former sages said that desire must not be indulged.

literal: My son is master of all under Heaven; if you gallop about hunting in the fields and by any chance there is a bit-in-the-mouth mishap, you will only send me grief.
idiomatic: My son is master of all under Heaven; if you gallop about hunting in the fields and by any chance there is a bit-in-the-mouth mishap, you will only send me grief.

literal: Deeply take warning of this!
idiomatic: Take this deeply to heart!

literal: " Ninth month, on bingyin day eastern frontier garrison soldiers were abolished.
idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on bingyin day, eastern frontier garrison troops were withdrawn.

literal: On gengwu day visited Rao Prefecture and made offerings at Emperor Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court visited Rao Prefecture and offered rites at Emperor Taizu's temple.

literal: On wuzi day Xiao Talin memorialized victory in campaigning against the Zubu.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiao Talin reported victory over the Zubu.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen new moon: encamped at Camel Mountain; tribute goods of the Xi King and the various tribes were abolished.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Camel Mountain and abolished tribute from the Xi King and the various tribes.

literal: On yiwei day seasonal clothing was granted to the palace guard.
idiomatic: On yiwei day seasonal clothing was granted to the palace guard.

literal: On dingyou day monasteries and mountain temples were forbidden to indiscriminately ordain monks and nuns.
idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict forbade monasteries and mountain temples from ordaining monks and nuns indiscriminately.

literal: On wuxu day the prohibition on fishing at the Tokyo circuit's Yu Marsh was lifted.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the ban on fishing at Yu Marsh on the Eastern Capital circuit was lifted.

literal: On wushen day because litigation at the Supreme Capital was numerous and redundant, those in charge were called to account.
idiomatic: On wushen day, because litigation at the Supreme Capital had become excessive, those responsible were called to account.

literal: On xinyou day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: Eleventh month, on renxu new moon: prisoners were reviewed; on bingxu day visited Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the eleventh month prisoners were reviewed; on bingxu day the court visited Xian Prefecture.

literal: On wuzi day visited Xian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court visited Xian Mausoleum.

literal: On gengyin day visited Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court visited Qian Mausoleum.

literal: That month, Goryeo King Wang Zhi died; his nephew Song dispatched Wang Tongying to come report.
idiomatic: That month Goryeo King Wang Zhi died; his nephew Song sent Wang Tongying to report the death.

literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day ice fishing was conducted on the Tu River.
idiomatic: On yisi day in the twelfth month the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.

literal: On jiyou day encamped at Camel Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court encamped at Camel Mountain.

literal: On renzi day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On renzi day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice for Goryeo King Wang Zhi; an edict ordered his nephew to administer state affairs provisionally.
idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were sent to mourn Goryeo King Wang Zhi, and an edict put his nephew in provisional charge of state affairs.

literal: On bingchen day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: That year jinshi Chen Ding and one other were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Chen Ding and one other passed the examinations.
